parts.prompt:
Why is a sawn timber plank still classed as a natural material?
A. Cutting makes a natural polymer synthetic
B. Sawing reshapes the existing natural material
C. A shaped object must be chemically synthesised
D. Natural classification depends on its original shape
parts.canonical_answer:
B. Sawing reshapes the existing natural material. Mechanical shaping does not change the natural origin of the wood.
Distractor explanations: A: Cutting changes shape without synthesising new polymer chains. C: Shaping does not imply chemical synthesis. D: Natural origin is not lost when the material is reshaped.
marking_guidance: Correct option B (1). B. Sawing reshapes the existing natural material. Mechanical shaping does not change the natural origin of the wood. Distractor explanations: A: Cutting changes shape without synthesising new polymer chains. C: Shaping does not imply chemical synthesis. D: Natural origin is not lost when the material is reshaped. No mark for more than one selected option.

Why can soap clean less efficiently in hard water?

B. Insoluble scum consumes some of the soap
